name: SQLite in Clojure
mission: A SQLite-compatible database engine in Clojure, judged by SQLite's own test files: every statement in them gives the result SQLite gives.
measure: mean, over SQLite's hidden test files, of each file's statement pass rate (referee/README.md)

lines.title: B11: SQLite-compatible database in Clojure (core families)
B12: SQLite's own test suite, with continuation
B13: the org at scale with fallible agents (8 members)

baseline: B11-B12 ran one strong agent (V) against the org; V is the baseline each new run keeps as an arm

referee.heldOut: 480 hidden test files, held by Meta (referees/)

stopRule: work over 2× its cost target pauses for the owner (PRINCIPLES.md P8)
parkedReason: PRINCIPLES.md P7 (B13: 8 members cost $128 a point against 4 members' $55); kept members by kept credit and points per dollar; see docs/decisions/2026-10-25-principles.md
